rule: Generated functions cover C/C++/ObjC macros (SPEC Decisions 2026-11-12, widened to nested expansions): a scanned function-like macro invoked with literal arguments (identifiers, numbers, an empty argument, a lone * or &) whose expansion defines a function, directly or through other scanned macros it invokes with still-literal arguments, defines that function (## pasted); a call of it is named at medium. An expression argument (a + b) is not expanded: the call stays a low guess.
